about.description: Bridge local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex) to messaging platforms (Feishu/Lark, DingTalk, Slack, Telegram, Discord, LINE, WeChat Work). Chat with your AI dev assistant from anywhere — no public IP required for most platforms.

name: v1.5.3
body:
## What's Changed

Stable release since **v1.5.2**, promoting **v1.5.3-beta.2** (`8f442161`) unchanged. It rolls up **65 merged pull requests** — 53 feature and fix changes, plus docs, tests and refactors — with the bulk of the work on Feishu cards and attachments, provider presets, and agent model and command handling.

Upgrading to v1.5.3 is recommended: every new option is optional and defaults to off.

### How this release was validated

- Unit, regression, performance and blackbox tests in CI on this commit.
- Release QA (`go test -race`, blackbox smoke) on the exact commit.
- Live Feishu channel smoke (Claude Code + Codex) on the release binary.
- Promoted from v1.5.3-beta.2 after its beta period and maintainer approval.

### New Features

- **Feishu:** Key tool parameters are shown in cards (#1944)
- **Feishu:** Plain text and image bursts can optionally be coalesced (#2022)
- **Feishu:** Lifecycle tracking through AsyncRecoverablePlatform (#1198)
- **Feishu:** Group reply-all is scoped to configured chats (#1976)
- **Feishu:** Streaming is configurable (#1956)
- **Feishu:** Messages that mention other users are skipped (#2012)
- **Cursor:** Falls back to local chat history (#2255)
- **Cursor:** /memory is persisted in the project AGENTS.md (#2245)
- **Cursor:** An optional instructions file is reloaded on every turn (#2095)
- **Claude Code:** The CLI's applied effort is shown in the reply footer (#2252)
- **Codex:** Named app-server permission profiles are supported (#2151)
- **ACP:** A compact command, context usage and form elicitation bridge (#1933)
- **ACP:** Model discovery and live switching via configOptions (#1935)
- **OpenCode:** Skill directories are exposed via SkillProvider (#1873)
- **Telegram:** Dice messages are forwarded to the agent as text (#2254)
- **Telegram:** Telegram Bot API 10.x native rich messages are supported (#1985)
- **WeCom:** Interactive card sending and callback feedback (#1645)
- **Slack:** An optional base_url overrides the Slack Web API root (#2178)
- **MiniMax:** M3.1 Flash is the default model (#1192)
- **Providers:** Runcrate provider preset (#2144)
- **Providers:** Opper provider preset (#2125)
- **Providers:** CloudGPU provider preset (#2166)

### Fixed

**Core and sessions**
- HTML tags written inside inline code are escaped (#2282)
- Splitting a message reserves its closing code fence (#2117)

**Claude Code**
- Session transcript lines over 256KB are read in /list and /history (#2192)
- The /model fallback list includes claude-fable-5 and follows the rolling fable alias (#1755, #1642)

**Feishu**
- Askq and permission card clicks are accepted only from the requester (#2281)
- The card answer is no longer echoed as a second chat message (#2290)
- Replies to bot menu events use the correct receive_id (#2259)
- Reply cards are filled and table columns are sized by content (#2235)
- Forwarded attachments are downloaded through the outer message (#2239)
- Post attachments from quotes, merge-forwards and failed downloads are surfaced (#1923)
- URLs in quoted interactive cards are preserved (#2142)
- The chat scope is checked before allow_from when a message arrives (#2223)
- Name lookups are bounded, so a hung request cannot hold a message (#2018)
- Silent WebSocket connections are recovered (#2120)
- The SDK logger respects the application log level (#2150)
- Progress card panels stay collapsed while a turn is running (#2199)

**Other platforms**
- **Discord:** AskUserQuestion option clicks are forwarded to the engine (#2219)
- **MAX:** Only private-dialog chats are cached for callback routing (#2284)
- **Slack:** base_url validation is tightened, a base_url secret is never echoed in a validation error, and base_url is displayed the same way in errors and logs (#2247, #2242, #2234)
- **Slack:** Edited @mentions are ignored instead of re-running the agent (#1579)
- **WPS Xiezuo:** style_content is parsed in rich text messages (#2198)
- **WeCom:** The required task_id is sent on button_interaction cards (#2283)
- **WeCom:** Quoted files are named and unavailable attachments are marked (#2225)

**Other agents**
- **Cursor:** Invented models are no longer listed when CLI discovery fails (#2094)
- **Pi:** Custom providers are merged into the model list and reasoning efforts are model-aware (#1872)

**Daemon, config and install**
- **Config:** Enabling multi-workspace mode from the dashboard no longer breaks startup, closing the issue reported in v1.5.2 (#2266)
- **Daemon:** launchd owns the restart transaction (#2286)

### Other Changes

- **i18n:** Russian translations read more clearly (#2101)

### Behavior changes worth knowing

- **MiniMax default model (#1192):** M3.1 Flash is now the default MiniMax model. Pass a model explicitly if you relied on the previous default.
- **Feishu group reply-all (#1976):** reply-all now only applies to the chats you configure; other group chats are not answered.
- **Feishu mentions of other users (#2012):** messages that mention another user are skipped instead of being answered.
- **Feishu card clicks (#2281):** askq and permission cards can only be clicked by the user who raised the request.
- **Slack edited mentions (#1579):** editing an @mention no longer re-runs the agent.

### Breaking Changes

None. All new options are optional with safe defaults.

### Contributors

Thanks to the **35 external contributors** who landed 62 changes in this release, and to the cc-connect team. 🎉
